# Engineering

Skills I use daily for code work. **User-invoked** skills are reachable only when typed (`disable-model-invocation: true`); **model-invoked** ones keep rich trigger phrasing in their description so the model can reach for them too. The list is generated from each skill's `description` by `scripts/build-catalog.py`.

<!-- skill-catalog:start: generated by scripts/build-catalog.py; edit the skills or third-party/skills.json, not this list -->

## User-invoked

- **[arch-review](./arch-review/SKILL.md)**: Scans the codebase for deepening, coupling, and maintainability candidates, saves a ranked Markdown report with diagrams and a status table to docs/arch-review/, then implements the batch you confirm as one stacked PR per candidate, decisions recorded, loose ends audited.
- **[docs-refactor](./docs-refactor/SKILL.md)**: Refactors a repo's docs so each kind of knowledge has exactly one home (README, setup, deployment, .env.example, glossary, ADRs), fixes every claim the code contradicts, and rewrites the agent instructions into a short, high-signal AGENTS.md. Stages the result on a new branch with a report and a PR body.
- **[review-doc](./review-doc/SKILL.md)**: Reviews a design doc, plan, RFC or spec with fresh sub-agents that never saw the conversation behind it (a paraphrase test, a simplicity-and-reuse check against the code, and an implementation-readiness check), then settles the findings with you, edits the doc, and repeats until two rounds in a row come back clean.
- **[test-review](./test-review/SKILL.md)**: Reviews a project's test setup for blind spots, wasted effort, and how the tests run; saves a ranked Markdown report with a status table to docs/test-review/, then fixes the batch you confirm (tdd for blind spots, prune-tests for waste), one stacked PR per candidate, loose ends audited.

## Model-invoked

- **[address-review-findings](./address-review-findings/SKILL.md)**: Works through the review feedback on GitHub pull requests (one PR, several, or a stack), pulling the unresolved threads, fixing what's real, then replying and resolving.
- **[attach-media](./attach-media/SKILL.md)**: Uploads local screenshots, images, GIFs, or screen recordings to GitHub and embeds them in a pull request, issue, or comment: the same attachment drag-and-drop makes in the web UI, no external hosting.
- **[conventional-commit](./conventional-commit/SKILL.md)**: Makes the agent's git commits: writes Conventional Commits v1.0.0 messages and splits the work into atomic commits when it spans concerns.
- **[download-media](./download-media/SKILL.md)**: Downloads the screenshots, recordings, and files attached to GitHub issues, pull requests, and comments so they can be looked at, including on private repos, where the attachment URLs 404 without auth.
- **[frontend-craft](./frontend-craft/SKILL.md)**: Designs and builds frontend UI with a deliberate point of view instead of templated defaults: picks the surface's mode, plans a compact token system, reviews the plan against the brief, builds to a quality floor, and checks the render in bounded passes. Also critiques or audits existing UI and handles bolder, quieter, simpler, or polish requests.
- **[pr-body](./pr-body/SKILL.md)**: Writes a pull request's title and body, shaped by the kind of change: a fix shows before → after, a feature shows it working, a refactor shows nothing changed, a chore stays a few lines.
- **[review-prs](./review-prs/SKILL.md)**: Code-reviews pull requests on GitHub or Azure DevOps, then comments the findings inline, fixes them and resolves the threads. Covers open PRs that no human has reviewed yet or that changed a lot since their last review, a PR or stack the user names, and a local diff since a commit, branch or tag.
- **[setup-lefthook](./setup-lefthook/SKILL.md)**: Sets up lefthook git hooks in a project: installs lefthook the way the stack expects, writes a lefthook.yml whose pre-commit jobs fix and check only what's staged, and adds a per-file token budget that blocks oversized agent-written files with instructions for splitting them.
- **[sync-and-branch](./sync-and-branch/SKILL.md)**: Puts work on a fresh branch cut from the up-to-date default branch (or a base the user names), carrying uncommitted changes along when they're the branch's work, or syncs a fork's default branch with its upstream.
